title: Acme Corp PTO Policy
body: Acme Corp provides flexible PTO for all full-time employees: no fixed accrual cap, but we ask that you take at least 15 days per year and coordinate time off of a week or longer with your manager at least two weeks in advance. Request PTO through the HR portal; your manager approves within 2 business days. Unused PTO does not carry over or pay out, since it's not accrual-based. Sick leave is separate and unlimited for genuine illness — no approval needed, just notify your manager. Contact Dana Okafor (HR lead) with policy questions.
